body_html:
DJ Jacky T.

Born and raised in Atlanta, DJ Jacky T. is an all-around entertainer with a passion for bringing energy to every event. He started DJing in 2023, but his experience in collegiate events and lively gatherings has shaped him into a natural crowd controller. Whether it’s a packed house party or a high-energy club night, Jacky T. knows how to set the vibe and keep the party going.

In his headphones, you’ll find a diverse mix of 80s and 90s classics, soft rock, early 2000s rap and R&B, late 2010s emo rap, and the golden era of 2010s EDM—a perfect blend for any crowd. For him, the best part of DJing is simple: getting paid to have fun and play music.

Beyond DJing, Jacky T. is a recording studio owner and sound engineer, helping artists bring their music to life. He’s also a talented actor and model, with a love for cinema that fuels his creativity. Whether he’s behind the decks, in the studio, or on set, he thrives on artistic expression.

With skills in singing, dancing, comedy, and undeniable charm, DJ Jacky T. is more than just a DJ—he’s a full-fledged entertainer ready to turn any event into an unforgettable experience
